## Objective
- Build a complete, playable fantasy game inspired by Arkenfall, with a much larger map, dragon boss fights, vampire and demon lords, monster-filled dark forests, and valuables to discover.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Include forest exploration, treasure, and boss fights.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone browser canvas game with a dark fantasy presentation and keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- Made relic gathering the progression gate for boss encounters.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with the game UI, HUD, minimap, touch controls, help modal, and responsive styling.
- Created most of `game.js`: map scenery and exploration, combat, enemies, loot/relics, progression, boss chain, minimap, and input handling.

### Active
- Validate and fix the game implementation; no browser test or screenshot has been run.
- Check `game.js` for syntax/runtime issues and verify the opening screen and gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `game.js` and run a syntax check; repair any issues.
2. Launch the game and verify it renders and plays, including controls, gathering, and boss progression.
3. Save and inspect a current screenshot if browser tooling is available.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and styles; loads `game.js`.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, map/game state, combat, loot, bosses, and controls.

## Important Context
- Files were created/edited in the working tree; no commit or push was made.
- A previous edit failed because its expected old string could not be found; subsequent writes/edit replaced or added relevant code, but the result has not been validated.
